component.name: Red
component.summary: YouTube client with TV mode, no ads

description.p: Red is a YouTube client for the Linux desktop: a native app to watch YouTube without ads, with a smart TV mode, a YouTube Music mode, SponsorBlock, media keys, a mini player and a built-in YouTube downloader. Sign in with your Google account and your subscriptions, history and recommendations work as on the website, in a lightweight window instead of a browser tab.
Three ways to watch, one window:

ul.li: Desktop mode: the full YouTube website, signed in, in light, dark or system theme, with picture-in-picture style mini player
TV mode: the YouTube Leanback interface from smart TVs and consoles, full screen, driven by keyboard, mouse or gamepad controller, ideal for a media center, living room PC or handheld
Music mode: YouTube Music in the same window, a music player with media keys, tray and MPRIS controls, background play, and audio downloads one click away
Ad blocker built in: video ads, banners and sponsored feed items are removed before the page renders, and playback is never touched
Tracker blocking, SponsorBlock to skip sponsor segments, intros and reminders, Return YouTube Dislike counts, and a switch to hide Shorts
YouTube video downloader for any video, playlist or channel, as MP4, MKV or WebM up to 4K
YouTube to MP3: save audio only as MP3, M4A, Opus, FLAC or WAV for music
Subtitles, thumbnail, metadata and chapters embedded; sponsor segments cut out on request
Playlists detected from any link, entries picked one by one, a queue with pause, resume and retry
Your YouTube sign-in is reused, so age-restricted videos and anything your account can watch download too
Media keys and MPRIS media controls, a tray icon with play, pause and skip, the screen kept awake while a video plays
Hardware video decoding, native Wayland and X11, notifications when a download finishes, single instance that opens YouTube links from the command line

description.p: Red is a lightweight alternative to the browser tab, to Electron YouTube apps and to a separate downloader. Everything works on any Linux distribution.

screenshot.caption: Watch YouTube without ads in desktop mode, with dislike counts and SponsorBlock markers
TV mode: the smart TV YouTube interface on your PC, with keyboard or gamepad
YouTube downloader: the download queue beside the page
Download a video as MP4, audio as MP3, or pick the exact streams; playlists are detected
Ad blocker, tracker blocking, SponsorBlock categories, dislikes and Shorts

description.p: Swipe to go back, finer TV speeds and a full-screen fix.

ul.li: Swipe two fingers on a touchpad to go back or forward in YouTube and YouTube Music; rows that scroll sideways keep the swipe
In TV mode, D and A change the playback speed in steps of 0.05, with Shift in steps of 0.25
The Autoplay option is now called Start videos without a click, with a note on where YouTube's own autoplay is
Leaving full screen brings back a maximized window instead of a smaller one
Check boxes, radio buttons, selection and the download dialog's choice in Red's red, and a softer border on the focused field

description.p: Easier to find your way around: a mode switch, a rail with labels, a welcome, and a mini player for Shorts and YouTube Music.

ul.li: A mode switch at the top of the rail for YouTube, YouTube Music and TV mode (Ctrl+1, Ctrl+2, Ctrl+3), and a Back to YouTube button in TV mode
Choose the mode Red opens in; it opens in YouTube by default
The side rail shows labels next to its icons, with a switch back to icons only
A welcome on the first start, and Show me around in the menu
The mini player fits Shorts in a tall window, works in YouTube Music, and has a button and Esc to go back; closing it no longer quits Red
Download cards with a right-click menu, keyboard actions and the full reason when a download fails; smooth progress bars
The Downloads panel opens over the page in narrow windows, and a message confirms each new download
Full keyboard access: F6 moves between the page, the rail and the Downloads panel; F10 opens the menu
Colours that follow YouTube's: red only for small marks, YouTube's pill buttons and blue controls
Optional middle-click scrolling
Fixed: skipping tracks from the desktop's media controls and Bluetooth headsets in YouTube Music, and Settings, General choices being forgotten after a restart

description.p: Organised downloads and YouTube Music's Download entry.

ul.li: Downloads sorted into Videos, Music, Playlists and Channels folders, with a switch to keep one flat folder
The Download entry in YouTube Music's menus downloads through Red
Fixed: the icon of the context menu's audio download entry

description.p: Music mode, an online guide and a bug report sheet, and fixes for the packaged builds.

ul.li: Music mode: YouTube Music in the same window (Ctrl+M), remembered across launches, playing on while you browse, with media keys, tray and desktop media controls and audio downloads one click away
What's new sheet on the first start of a new version
Online guide and a Report a bug sheet that opens a pre-filled issue or an email with the diagnostics attached
Optional playback progress bar behind the taskbar entry
Upsell pop-ups removed with the ads
Fixed: F11 in the snap and Flatpak builds, pop-up window dialogs, the YouTube Music "No internet connection" banner, long drop-down lists, long titles in the tray menu

description.p: Red 10 is a redesigned Red on Qt 6 and Qt WebEngine.

ul.li: Desktop and TV modes in one window, switchable at any time
Ad and tracker blocking that never touches playback; SponsorBlock; Return YouTube Dislike; Hide Shorts
Downloads: video, audio only or exact streams, playlists and channels, subtitles, thumbnails and chapters embedded, sign-in reused for restricted videos
Media keys, MPRIS, tray controls, mini player, screen kept awake while playing
A new design that follows YouTube's light and dark themes
